page_subtitle: Every order is recorded here first, then sent to its destination; nothing leaves the queue until the destination has answered.
stale_alert: {n} order(s) have been waiting for more than 24 hours to be transmitted. Check the transmission screen.
rejected_subtitle: The destination refused their content. Correct the order (customer, phone, address), then resend it.
waiting_subtitle: Retried automatically, oldest first, with a growing delay — never dropped.
waiting_empty: Nothing waiting: every order has been transmitted.
resend_failed: The order could not be queued again.
load_failed: The transmission state could not be loaded.
rejected_alert: {n} order(s) were rejected by the destination. Correct them and resend.
